summary: Hallmark Venture Group filed an 8-K reporting a change of control via a private agreement: Selkirk Global Holdings sold its 100% of Series A Preferred Stock (voting control) and Hallmark issued 50M common shares (~75.55% of common) to Equorix LLC. No consideration price was disclosed for the stock. Simultaneously, Hallmark acquired drone IP from Cho Sun Sik and Sundori Korea. Board changed with three new directors. As a private share issuance and asset acquisition, this is not a standard special situation. Watch for shareholder litigation or SEC scrutiny on valuation.
